name: litigation-fee-calculator
description: Litigation cost calculator expert: computes Chinese court statutory fees (acceptance + application) and estimates lawyer, notary, appraisal, evaluation, auction, announcement, translation and travel costs across all case types, split into statutory and estimated layers.

displayDescription.en: Computes court statutory fees and estimates full litigation-related costs (lawyer, notary, appraisal, etc.) across all case types, with statutory vs estimated split.
displayDescription.zh: 测算法院法定诉讼费与律师、公证、鉴定等全部维权成本，覆盖各类案件，区分法定与估算两层。
